description: Suede Labs Android app factory: plan, build, test, and release a production-grade native Android app from a product idea through Google Play. Use for requests to create, ship, submit, monetize, or modernize an Android app. Covers Kotlin and Jetpack Compose architecture, API-level policy verification, accessibility, privacy and Data Safety, Play Billing, Play Integrity, account deletion, testing, performance, store assets, signing, staged rollout, and a release evidence gate.
